observed: Fresh local instance contained no installed apps.
CLI init and deploy created a local Git source project and installed its Ink app.
The desktop launcher showed the explicitly installed app.
Opening the app rendered its Ink view using the SDK styles.
Keyboard activation of Add one changed the displayed count from 0 to 1.
A separate CLI call added 4 and the open app updated from 1 to 5 without reloading.
limitations: Single local browser validation, not a multi-machine collaboration or performance measurement.
Native execution, desktop packaging, source migration and full cloud provisioning remain separate acceptance work.
